name: Micah
overview: The biblical figure Micah appears in various genealogical records as a descendant of Mephibosheth, also known as Meribbaal, illustrating his place within the family lines of Ephraim and Reuben. The sample verses highlight Micah as a son and father within these lines, emphasizing his role in the continuity of Israel's tribes. This background sets the stage for understanding the prophetic Micah, who denounces idolatry and injustice in Israel, foretells restoration, and prophesies the coming Messiah, rooted in a faithful lineage and covenantal history.
